The derivation assumes transferable capabilities (like critical thinking) can be taught as a generic 'common core' independent of deep domain knowledge. Cognitive science evidence suggests reasoning skills are largely domain-specific; attempting to teach them as abstract modules may fail to generate the intended adaptability, thus contradicting the claim that this approach is robust to change.
